barriers: Closed monograph: the upstream source of all 483 records and of the motif classification scheme is Płonka (2003), 'The portable art of Mesolithic Europe' (Acta Universitatis Wratislaviensis, Wrocław), described by the authors as an 'analogue compilation' from which 'the South Scandinavian data were manually extracted and digitised' (p.2). This is a paywalled or closed print monograph with no PID: Tier 3.

Dataset 1, the authors' digitised South Scandinavian Mesolithic ornamentation dataset (483 objects; presence/absence motif coding plus location, context quality, source, chronology and artefact type), is deposited openly on Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.10623550; later version 10.5281/zenodo.10801706, same concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10623549): Tier 0.

Record-weighted coverage cannot be separated meaningfully from the dataset count. The deposit is a full transcription of the relevant upstream records, so 483/483 analytical records are Tier 0, but the upstream catalogue records themselves are Tier 3. The category is assigned from the dataset-count coverage (1/2 = 50%) under the procedure as written, which counts upstream sources.
